parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoints that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to obtain the region ID

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to have a token for the next query. Valid values:
If this is the first query or there is no next query, you do not need to specify this parameter.
If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the instance. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`

ProtectedEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether managed protection is enabled. This parameter takes effect only for calls made by using Security Token Service (STS). Valid values:

true: Managed protection is enabled. After managed protection is enabled, only the same user who created the endpoint can modify or delete the endpoint by using STS.

false: Managed protection is disabled

是否开启托管保护，STS 调用方式下生效。取值：

true：开启。开启托管保护后，只有和创建时相同的用户才能通过
STS 方式对该终端节点进行修改或者删除等操作。

false：不开启
